title: Disability Benefits:Paralympic athlete says her "lifeline" has been cut
description:
Paralympic wheelchair sprint athlete Carly Tait says the changes in the disability benefits rules means she'll now be left without the car she desperately needs and could wreck her chances of qualifying for Team GB at this summer's Rio Games. .
